question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Benign
solution:
The correct answer is **"Malignant".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antonym **means opposite of another word.
 
• **Benign -** Kind or gentle.
 
 
• **Example -** *The audience is more benign*.
 
 
 
• **Malignant - **Dangerous or injurious or evil.
 
 
• **Example -*** She developed malignant liver cancer.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amiable -** Friendly and pleasant.

 
 
• **Example -** *He is a charming, amiable man.*
 
 
 
• **Compassionate -** Sympathetic or wanting to help others.
 
 
• **Example -*** He is a good speaker and compassionate man.*
 
 
 
• **Gentle -** Kind and calm.
 
 
• **Example -** *Ravi is a gentle boy.*
